Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
FADE IN:

INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY

The room is filled with officials, reporters, and cameras. A large banner reads "WORLD RECORD HOLDER" in bold letters. At the center of the room, a frail but determined 127-year-old man, GEORGE, is seated in a wheelchair. He is surrounded by his family and friends, all beaming with pride.

GEORGE
(whispering to himself)
I Did It. I Really Did It.

The officials present George with a certificate and a gold medal, proclaiming him the oldest human to ever live.

GEORGE
(overcome with emotion)
Thank You. Thank You So Much.

The room erupts in applause as George is lifted out of his wheelchair and carried to the stage. He is showered with congratulations and well-wishes.

CUT TO:

INT. GEORGE'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

George lies in bed, surrounded by photos and mementos from his long life. He gazes up at the ceiling, a faraway look in his eyes.

GEORGE
(whispering to himself)
Quantum Immortality... I Remember Now.

Suddenly, a look of horror crosses his face. He begins to shake and tremble.

GEORGE
(panicked)
What If I'm Not Alone? What If I'm Just A Simulation?

George's mind starts to unravel as he recalls the theory he read online years ago. He becomes convinced that he is living in a simulated reality, and that his entire life has been a mere simulation.

GEORGE
(rocking back and forth)
I'm Not Really Here. I'm Just A Program.

George's family and friends try to calm him down, but he becomes increasingly agitated.

GEORGE
(screaming)
I'M NOT ALONE! I'M NOT ALONE!

The room descends into chaos as George's mental breakdown reaches its peak. His family and friends are left to wonder if they will ever be able to reach the man they once knew.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

INT. GEORGE'S BEDROOM - LATER

George lies in bed, his mind still reeling from the revelation. He stares up at the ceiling, his eyes sunken and his face gaunt.

GEORGE
(whispering to himself)
I'm Not Alone. I'm Not Alone.

The camera lingers on George's face, a haunting expression of confusion and despair.

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
